findings.invariant_or_frz: FRZ-EVOL-06 / F-P0-03 (Mode B negative cases must fail closed with a structured diagnosis)
findings.description: When a replay JUnit omits a node that the VL3 manifest requires, verify_mode_b records 'missing manifest node in replay' and then dereferences replay_outcomes[n] for the same node, raising KeyError before returning the problem list.
findings.reproduction: evidence/logs/probe_modeb.log (MB3, MB5) and evidence/logs/mode_b_adv_dropped.log: CLI verify-test-execution --certification with a JUnit missing one testcase exits 1 with a KeyError traceback instead of the documented exit 2 with EVIDENCE_INTEGRITY_FAIL.
findings.impact: Fail-closed is preserved (non-zero exit, no false PASS). Diagnostic output and exit-code contract are degraded. The 'missing in replay' and 'missing manifest node' messages computed first are lost.
findings.parent_relevance: Does not block scoped closure: no pass path is created.
findings.minimal_corrective_action: Implementer-only: replace replay_outcomes[n] with replay_outcomes.get(n) in the non-passed comprehension and add a regression test for a dropped node. Any change to audited code requires a new audited SHA and is not done by the auditor.
findings.closure_criterion: Mode B with a dropped node returns exit 2 and lists 'missing in replay' / 'missing manifest node in replay'.
findings.independent_verification_required: yes (re-audit of the changed verifier if corrected)

findings.invariant_or_frz: FRZ-EVOL-06; master plan v3 Part II-B ('Document in evol_frz_evidence.v1 footnote for FRZ-EVOL-06')
findings.description: The FINAL bundle states the EVOL_CONSERVATIVE_FULL (not PLATFORM_CONSERVATIVE_FULL) scope for FRZ-EVOL-06 only inside the test (POLICY_ID assertion). The evidence row carries an empty scope_footnote; verify_mode_a requires footnotes only for FRZ-EVOL-07/08/10.
findings.impact: A reader of the bundle alone could mistake the FRZ-EVOL-06 evidence for platform-wide selection evidence. The bundle is digest-frozen and cannot be edited without a new FINAL publication.
findings.parent_relevance: Not blocking if the scope statement travels with the acceptance: it is stated in the IIAC pass record and FRZ matrix (LIM-01).
findings.minimal_corrective_action: Certifier carries the LIM-01 footnote verbatim into any FRZ-EVOL-06 row text. Optionally add FRZ-EVOL-06 to FRZ_SCOPE_FOOTNOTE_REQUIRED in a future evidence publication.
findings.closure_criterion: Any FRZ-EVOL-06 promotion text contains the EVOL_CONSERVATIVE_FULL-only scope statement.

findings.location: testing_support/change_safety/graph/traversal.py, discovery/extractors.py (_e15_tested_by), graph/builder.py (tests scanned only for TESTED_BY/GATED_BY)
findings.invariant_or_frz: FRZ-EVOL-01 / FRZ-EVOL-06; EVOL-01 target 'affected ... tests'; mandatory outcome 'typed edges ... test ownership'
findings.production_path: none (qualification tooling); consumer risk for ENT-AUDIT-X / SCENARIO-READINESS-X if they rely on test ownership
findings.description: TESTED_BY edges are derived only from a test module's direct imports. Tests that reach a changed module through test-side helper modules or implicit conftest fixtures are not enumerated. Independent AST reverse-import closure over 60 stratified real changes: 0 production modules missed (75,380 closure elements), 4,161 test modules missed (2,803 test_* suites, 1,317 helper/support modules, 41 conftest modules).
findings.impact: Impact assessment under-reports impacted tests outside the direct-import graph. Safety suites in T1/T2 run unconditionally and the EVOL selection universe is the scoped EVOL_CONSERVATIVE_FULL set, so no EVOL-X mechanical exit criterion is violated. Platform-wide test selection built on this graph would under-select.
findings.parent_relevance: Not blocking for the scoped EVOL-X closure. Must be a stated limitation (LIM-03).
findings.minimal_corrective_action: Extend TESTED_BY derivation through test-side helper modules and conftest (or declare test ownership explicit), then re-measure with the independent AST oracle.
findings.closure_criterion: Independent AST closure probe shows 0 missed test_* suites for the sampled population, or ENT-AUDIT-X records an explicit non-reliance on EVOL-X test ownership.

findings.invariant_or_frz: EVOL-M-03 (>=98% on S1..S6); metric spec oracle O-F vs O-X
findings.description: EVOL-M-03 is measured on six arcs that all change files inside the EVOL-X self-surface (testing_support/change_safety/*), so every arc selects the same 347-node set. The oracle is O-X (spec: 'Non-causal; documented limitation'), and m03_oracle_declared.v1.json holds null expected_consumers for all arcs, which makes 'oracle_matches_independent' true by construction. The independent AST reverse-closure oracle is real, but the declared-oracle cross-check is vacuous.
findings.reproduction: evidence/logs/probe_selection_rows.json: 56 stratified real paths produce only two selection sizes (57 and 347); 0 under-selection; unknown paths conservative.
findings.impact: M-03 shows internal consistency, not discrimination power. The auditor's own probe found no safety violation in scope.
findings.parent_relevance: Not blocking; documented O-X limitation in the spec.
findings.minimal_corrective_action: Add non-self-surface arcs with declared (non-null) expected consumers and re-measure M-03.
findings.closure_criterion: M-03 population includes arcs outside the EVOL-X self-surface with independently declared expectations.

findings.invariant_or_frz: FRZ-EVOL-08 (what changed / what failed / which deploy introduced regression); EVOL-M-09; OD-EVOL-08, OD-EVOL-13
findings.description: The dossier answers what changed, blast radius, selected tests, compatibility, deploy safety and freshness. M-09A maps a seed changed path to its DIRECT module node (tool time 0.49-0.94 s). Neither ingests failure evidence or deploy identity, and the human attribution SLA (median <= 900 s) is NOT_MEASURED by OD-EVOL-13. The literal checklist phrases 'what failed' and 'which deploy introduced regression' are covered only through seed attribution.
findings.impact: FRZ-EVOL-08 evidence supports change-time diagnostics only. Incident and deploy correlation is explicitly delegated to ENT-AUDIT-X in the bundle footnote.
findings.parent_relevance: Not blocking under the operator-approved OD-EVOL-13 scope; must be published as a scoped row (LIM-02).
findings.minimal_corrective_action: Run the human drill (HUMAN_FULL profile) or add failure/deploy-identity inputs to the dossier; keep FRZ-EVOL-08 text scoped until then.
findings.closure_criterion: FRZ-EVOL-08 promotion text carries 'change-time diagnostics; incident/deploy correlation owned by ENT-AUDIT-X; M-09H not measured'.
findings.independent_verification_required: no for scoped text; yes for any widening

findings.invariant_or_frz: FRZ-EVOL-07; master plan Part X; OD-EVOL-05b Option 1
findings.production_path: ActivationService.rollback is not gated by the assessor
findings.description: S7 negative arm records ad_layer_alone_succeeds=True: the production rollback path accepts a rollback that the assessor refuses (DM-04, forward-only durable migration). Auditor exhaustive enumeration of 384 DeployFacts combinations found no combination that the assessor marks eligible for missing evidence, forward-only durable rollback, incompatible persisted schema or non-drainable in-flight pins.
findings.impact: Unsafe rollback is refused explicitly by the qualification-layer assessor but not blocked in operator environments. Part X forbids claiming production enforcement.
findings.parent_relevance: Operator-approved scope (OD-EVOL-05b Option 1; W4-04 not authorized). Not blocking for a scoped row; blocks any production-enforcement claim.
findings.minimal_corrective_action: None for scoped row. For production claim: OD-EVOL-05b Option 2 + W4-04 default-off precondition port + strict-composition negative tests.
findings.closure_criterion: FRZ-EVOL-07 text carries the qualification-layer footnote; no document claims production durable-state enforcement.

findings.description: The frozen-core registry names 9 surfaces. Auditor classification of every tracked file: all intergrax/*.py outside the 9 surfaces are UNCLASSIFIED (fail-safe Class C), so core Python edits cannot pass as EXTENSION_ONLY. Non-registry JSON and Markdown are exempt: 405 markdown files and one JSON data file (intergrax/runtime/architecture/capability_edge_catalog.json) under intergrax/ classify EXTENSION_ONLY at TES.
findings.impact: An edit to the capability edge catalog is invisible to the extension-safety gate. Low: the file is data, and other gates (CW, COMPAT) cover it.
findings.minimal_corrective_action: Add data files under frozen surfaces (or an explicit registry row for capability_edge_catalog.json).
findings.closure_criterion: probe_assess.py reports no EXTENSION_ONLY classification for tracked JSON under intergrax/.

findings.invariant_or_frz: IIAC N-03 (auditor product write-surface), certifier gate
findings.description: (a) product_paths_changed_between(audited, audit_execution_sha) flags any intergrax/agents/applications change. Between TES and current HEAD 34 such files changed (ENT-AUDIT-X implementation commits by the repository owner); 0 changed between TES and FINAL; 0 EVOL-X-scope files changed anywhere. A manifest using HEAD as audit_execution_sha would fail strict mode for reasons unrelated to the auditor. The draft manifest therefore uses FINAL (the last exact-SHA replay checkout) as audit_execution_sha (IIAC-GOV-1 precedent: audit_execution_sha = test_execution_sha) and records HEAD in audit_session_head_sha. (b) The closure preflight still requires legacy gates (OD-EVOL-11 auditor_id, OD-EVOL-12, OD-EVOLX-08, b6_acceptance_publication_sha) that the IIAC migration matrix maps to the certifier gate; and it accepts any file matching the glob names as the pass record/manifest.
findings.impact: Certification publication cannot be completed by the auditor and may need a governance decision on the legacy preflight rows.
findings.parent_relevance: Certifier/operator action; does not alter the audit verdict.
findings.minimal_corrective_action: Certifier reconciles preflight rows with the IIAC migration matrix under its own ticket, and validates the final manifest (not only filename presence).
findings.closure_criterion: verify_iiac_audit_manifest.py and verify_iiac_role_separation.py --strict-product-diff exit 0 on the certifier-completed manifest; preflight accepts IIAC-mapped gates only after validation.

findings.invariant_or_frz: IIAC handoff record (mandatory per audit); manifest implementation_session_id / certifier fields
findings.description: No operator-attested Session C handoff record exists, EVOL-X implementer session ids are not recorded in the repository, and certifier session/agent ids and certification_publication_sha are not yet known. The auditor cannot attest to them and has not invented them.
findings.impact: The manifest is a draft until the operator attests the handoff and the certifier fills its fields.
findings.minimal_corrective_action: Operator completes IIAC_SESSION_HANDOFF_RECORD_EVOL_X_SESSION_C.md (draft provided); certifier completes manifest.
findings.closure_criterion: Handoff record signed; manifest validators pass.

findings.description: Digests must be computed over git blob bytes: hashing CRLF working-tree bytes mismatches blobs. Replays must run in short-path worktrees (known F-B6-AUD-01). The auditor's first tamper probe (probe_tamper.log) hashed working-tree bytes, so its 'DETECTED' rows for T2-T10 were detected for the wrong reason; it was superseded by probe_tamper_v2.log (blob-based digests, 12/12 detected for the correct reason). Both logs are preserved; only v2 is relied on.
findings.impact: None on the verdict; disclosure of an auditor tooling error.
